**Title:** The Flower City Waltz

**Key:** G Major

}

  Walk -- ing down by the Gen -- ee -- se \river,

  In the heart of the city.

  Where the mu -- sic starts to play.
  Taste the food and see the art,
  In the light of the day.
  
  Read the books in the li -- brary,
  Where the knowl -- edge is so deep.
  Then go up to the park -- way,
  While the world is fast asleep.
  
  Roch -- es -- ter, Roch -- es -- ter,
  Roch -- es -- ter, Roch -- es -- ter.
}

  <<
